actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly drawn COMPLETE single frame, NOT a sprite sheet. This is frame 04 of a WALK cycle for the exact star formation girl. Reference 1 is immutable character design; reference 2 only painting finish; reference 3 fixed chibi body size.
Draw her in STRICT EAST SIDE ELEVATION facing SCREEN RIGHT: one visible eye, pure side silhouette nose points horizontally right, NO three-quarter face. Torso and both boots point right too. Camera sees her anatomical RIGHT side. Her near RIGHT hand MUST hold her circular astrolabe. Her far LEFT hand holds exactly three star cards beyond torso, only partly visible; do not reverse these objects. Near astrolabe sits before chest, far star cards only peek beyond it.
Keep original dark high bun, gold-and-red-star diadem, face, black red ivory gold robe with celestial embroidery, orbit pendants, black gold red-star boots, large round chibi head and short limbs. Exact same hand props, no sword or staff addition. Hair falls down with just a small lag, NOT windblown horizontally.
POSE: Phase04: RIGHT BOOT IS THE BOOT ON SCREEN LEFT, behind the other boot. Keep it on screen LEFT, closer toward center than reference3 by 20px. It is the foreground boot, its heel lifts 25px, toe 12px. The LEFT boot is far boot on SCREEN RIGHT: its entire SOLE REMAINS FLAT ON GROUND y942; keep this support boot on screen right. DO NOT SWAP LEGS. Foreground right knee bends forward 20 degrees while right foot is still behind far left support. Same support as ref3. Left boot planted; right boot trailing and airborne. This is early swing, not forward heel contact. Short slow WALK. Hips centered x512, ground anchor (512,942) in 1024 coordinates; full height about 900px. Head/torso/hand-prop locations consistent with reference3; hair falls down, minimal secondary motion. Newly articulate legs, not copy pose.
Render one original complete character at 1024x1024 or larger NATIVE canvas, actual transparent RGBA background. Full bun, hair, props, tassels and soles inside with margin. NO shadow, no ground ellipse, no background, no text, no checkerboard. Polished rounded Chinese Daoist chibi painted style, elegant ornate gold engraving and clean sharp edges. Do not copy, rotate, mirror or deform another pose to fake a frame.
